summary: Produced a compiling TikZ reconstruction (version 1, best version). The figure is rectangle ABCD with M on AD, E and N on BC, F on DC, and segments AE, MN (parallel to AE), BF through O, and NF. A right-angle mark is drawn at the foot of AE on BF. The critic scored it 0.92, all nine labels (A, B, C, D, E, F, M, N, O) are present, and must_repair is false.
